_comment: SR-12: the ROLLBACK FLOOR. Each entry is a commit that closed a governance or authorization
defect. Rolling the deployed image back past the newest of these RE-OPENS that defect, so
scripts/check_rollback_safety.py refuses such a rollback unless it is forced explicitly.
This file is the reviewable record. Add an entry whenever a commit closes an authz/authority
defect; check_rollback_safety.py --audit warns when a commit whose subject looks like a
governance fix is missing here, so forgetting to add one is visible rather than silent.
Dates are commit dates (%cI) from the stewie-sw/stewie history.
